definition: Kindly disposed and actively doing good for other people.
author: Alexandre Dumas
quote: Faria, the beneficent and cheerful companion, with whom he was accustomed to live so intimately, no longer breathed.
example_sentence: A beneficent stranger paid for our coffees.
